.copr: Fedora COPR build entry point that builds the RPM from this repository
.github: GitHub Actions workflows for tests, releases, Claude and the autopilot, plus issue and PR templates
.gitignore: Files Git should ignore: build output and packaging scratch
AGENTS.md: Working guidelines for AI and code agents contributing to Satur8
CHANGELOG.md: Release notes for every Satur8 version, newest first
CONTRIBUTING.md: How to contribute: build, test, and PR guidelines
Cargo.lock: Exact pinned versions of every dependency for reproducible builds
Cargo.toml: Rust workspace manifest listing the crates and shared dependencies
LICENSE: The GPL-3.0-or-later license that covers all of Satur8
PACKAGING.md: Maintainer guide for release and packaging work
PLAN.md: Design notes on how Satur8 is built and why each backend exists
README.md: Project overview, install guide, and usage for Satur8
ROADMAP.md: What ships next for Satur8, in order
assets: KWin effect and focus script, GNOME extension, gamescope shader, and README images
benchmarks: Recorded CS2 frame-rate benchmark runs with Satur8 on and off
crates: Rust source code: core saturation math, CLI, GUI, daemon, tray, and display backends
packaging: Installer plus Arch, Fedora, and release-tarball packaging scripts
scripts: Maintainer scripts for benchmarks, README images, and releases
